messages:
maria: kicking off the 10:30 UTC router shift for release/optimizer-v3. plan: stagger 10% every 3m across eu-west -> us-east -> ap-south. quiet window 10:30-11:30 UTC. I’ll trigger the deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: initiating shift id=shift-20260321-01 target=optimizer-v3 
config:
  cohorts: [eu-west, us-east, ap-south]
  step_size: 10%
  step_interval: 180s
  rollback_on: p95>200ms OR error_rate>0.5% for 2 windows

leo: noted. I'll watch latency and socket errors on eu-west. hitting canary endpoints now `/health` + `/predict?test=true`.

ops-anna: router capacity checked — eu-west edge pools warmed, avg CPU 62%, p95 tokenization ~85ms. lowering LB drain timeout to 20s for this window. :thumbsup:

jess: release notes are up: https://redwood.in/releases/opt-v3-notes (summary + perf graphs). patch includes new KV cache eviction heuristic. :rocket:

deploy-bot: step 1 complete — eu-west at 10% -> status ok, errors 0.01%, p95 +4ms. advancing in 3m unless escalation.

maria: good. ops-anna, if you see >0.3% errors bump and pin. leo keep an eye on 503s.

leo: saw a transient spike 503 -> 3 calls in 30s (possibly delayed warmup). not sustained. continuing monitor.

sam: posting quick rollback checklist in case:
```
1) run: `deploy-bot pause shift shift-20260321-01`
2) run: `deploy-bot revert router-pin optimizer-v2`
3) notify infra oncall, open incident channel
4) revert config in traffic-router tagging
```

jess: added a small smoke test set to the canary run (end-to-end prompts). results look fine. no semantic regressions detected.

deploy-bot: step 2 complete — eu-west 20%, us-east 10%. Metrics snapshot:
- eu-west: p95 +6ms, err 0.02%
- us-east: p95 +3ms, err 0.01%

ops-anna: bumped circuit-breaker threshold lower for this shift (1000->900) just to limit surge risk. will relax after 11:30 UTC.

maria: reminder — if any region hits p95>200ms OR errors>0.5% for two consecutive checks we stop and pin back. also: tag the deploy thread in the release notes.

leo: us-east p95 steady. ap-south still cold, waiting for warmup.

deploy-bot: step 3 complete — eu-west 40%, us-east 20%, ap-south 10%.

jess: I see ap-south p95 +30ms but error rate 0.05% — within safe. proceeding.

leo: spotted a small increase in TCP connect failures from one ap-south edge node (node-a3). routed around it, degraded but ok. ops-anna watching.

ops-anna: taken node-a3 OOS for now, backfills healthy. no user-facing impact so far.

deploy-bot: step 4 complete — eu-west 60%, us-east 40%, ap-south 20%.

maria: nice. posting a brief note to #incidents if anything pops.

deploy-bot: step 5 complete — eu-west 80%, us-east 60%, ap-south 40%. no thresholds breached.

jess: quick perf note — KV hit-rate improved ~7% on v3 in canary. tracking in console.

deploy-bot: final step — shifting to 100% over remaining window.

deploy-bot: shift complete. all cohorts at 100% for optimizer-v3. summary: p95 change +8ms avg, error_rate +0.02% absolute. no auto-rollback triggered.

maria: great job. leaving a 1hr watch — if anything degrades we follow the rollback checklist. tagging release-bot to publish final note.

release-bot: published release/optimizer-v3: https://redwood.in/releases/opt-v3-notes — change window 10:30-11:30 UTC, shift id shift-20260321-01, rollback policy linked. :white_check_mark:

leo: continuing to monitor for the next 30m, will DM if anything.

ops-anna: metrics look stable. reverting circuit-breaker threshold back to default in 30m.

maria: thanks everyone. closing this thread after watch period. :tada:
